jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Responsibilities Kforce has a client in Irving, TX that is seeking a Data Engineer. jobs.title: Data Analyst I
jobs.description: At Acorns, our mission is to look after the financial best interests of the up-and-coming, beginning with the empowering, proud step of micro-investing. How do we accomplish our mission? Our values. Lead With Heart - With compassion, integrity, and tenacity, inspire yourself and others to move past all previous thresholds of possibility Make Bold Decisions - We are creating a new world. Be optimistic, adventurous, and courageous. Leap fearlessly into the future Always Build Trust - Say what you mean, mean what you say, and do what you say you’re going to do. We are all owners. We are one team Never Stop Growing - Change IS the constant. Stay hungry and curious. Be relentless in the pursuit of progress Find a way - Never settle, no excuses, nothing is impossible. Just make it happen Our values guide us, and our mission drives us. Come join us and help deliver financial wellness for the whole family, putting the tools of wealth-making into everyone’s hands. Data Analyst I | Acorns Acorns is seeking a Data Analyst I to serve as a key partner for our Core Experience team, specifically focused on our Investing and Banking product lines. In this role, you will leverage data to optimize the customer journey, working at the intersection of Product, Finance, and Operations to ensure our core features deliver maximum value to our customers. You will play a vital role in shaping the product roadmap by transforming raw data into actionable insights that drive retention and enhance the overall customer experience. Acorns is a remote-first organization, offering the flexibility to work remotely while providing optional access to office space in Irvine, CA. What You Will Do At Acorns Collaborate with the Core Experience team to drive the ideation and rigorous analysis of product experiments. Partner with Product, Finance, and Operations to build and maintain robust reports and dashboards specifically for our Core Experience product lines. Write and optimize complex SQL queries to extract data from various sources for deep-dive analysis. Utilize Databricks and DBT to transform raw data into clean, accessible datasets for the broader team. Design and manage intuitive Tableau dashboards that track key performance indicators (KPIs) for Investing and Banking features. Monitor customer behavior and product performance using Amplitude to identify opportunities for friction reduction and growth. Work with managers and cross-functional teams to establish priorities, including new infrastructure and tool building. What You Will Bring To Acorns 3+ years of Analytics experience, preferably supporting product development or financial services. Strong SQL skills for data extraction and experience with data visualization tools like Tableau. A solid understanding of statistical concepts and hands-on experience of A/B testing methodologies and product experimentation. Familiarity with modern data stack tools such as Databricks, DBT, and product analytics platforms like Amplitude. The ability to translate complex numerical findings into clear, persuasive recommendations for non-technical stakeholders in Finance and Operations. Hunger to deliver game-changing products. Exceptional drive and precision in delivery. A belief that your work is tied to your life's mission. Optimistic about the potential of societal change. You are not expected to have experience with all listed requirements. If you feel passionate about Acorns' mission, vision, and values, please apply. What We Offer Competitive salary and stock options A comprehensive benefits package for you and your family Flexible work location, hours, and paid time off 401(k) matching Monthly Acorns account contribution & GoHenry account for your family Mindfulness and Financial Wellness resources, Headspace and Addition Wealth Acorns Career Development Program (Ongoing training sessions, development plans, development check-ins, Cornerstone’s online training platform) Roots Leadership Program for Emerging Leaders Community week onsite gatherings and various virtual events Talented and motivated team members who care deeply about one another, our mission, and our customers. The rare opportunity to create a new world. We inspire one another every day to do meaningful work that solves big societal challenges. About Acorns Acorns is a financial wellness app that helps everyday people and families save and invest money for the long term. Since 2014, Acorns has grown into a global company with multiple life-stage products serving the needs of kids, teens, adults, and parents. Named one of Time’s “World’s Best Brands of 2024,” Acorns has helped over 14 million people save & invest over $25 billion dollars, much of it from spare change and small amounts. Compensation Information The pay range for this position at commencement of employment is expected to be between $121,000 and $140,000/year; however, base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including equity grants, and discretionary cash bonus awards in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as vacation, sick time, and parental leave), dependent on the position offered. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment. If hired, employee will be in an “at-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors. Work Authorization Acorns participates in E-Verify to confirm the employment eligibility of all newly hired employees. For more information about E-Verify, please visit www.e-verify.gov

jobs.title: Data Engineer - Information Systems
jobs.description: Forbes named Mesa Public Schools in their list of 2024 Best Employers in Arizona. East Valley Tribune names Mesa Public Schools as Best Place to Work in East Valley for multiple years. Employment Type: Full-time Base Salary: $73,403.00 Class/Calendar: D61-IS, 12 months Benefits: Vacation, sick leave, holidays, retirement matched through the Arizona State Retirement System, health, and life insurance Performance Pay: Available annually New Hire Experience: 1% of the base hourly rate granted for each year of verified like experience (within ten years) beyond the requirement, up to a ten-year maximum New Hire Education: 1% of the base hourly rate awarded for an AA or higher degree if not required for the position Job Summary: Mesa Public Schools is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Data Engineer. You will assume a strategic role in developing and maintaining the data infrastructure for our K-12 system. Working closely with cross-functional teams, including a Senior Research Analyst and Business Intelligence Lead, a Senior Data Engineer and other research and reporting team members, you will lead the creation and implementation of a cohesive and extensive enterprise-wide data model. Collaborating with a diverse team of data experts and educators, you will play a pivotal role in leveraging data insights to enhance educational outcomes. Key Responsibilities: Technical Expertise and Cloud Adoption Provide technical knowledge for major data strategies, driving the organization’s success in adopting modern data models and cloud technologies. Guide technical architecture for projects such as data replication, metadata management, DBaaS, data modeling and data security. Develop proof-of-concept prototypes and initial implementation models to support the vision and strategy of the district. Leverage your deep understanding of SQL and knowledge of development languages (e.g. Python, R) to guide the development and maintenance of data engineering pipelines, supporting modeling and analytics needs. Define and maintain reusable data development patterns, engineering standards, version control and data frameworks. Database Technology and Platform Designs Apply expert knowledge of database technology to support legacy DBMSs and design overall data platform solutions. Utilize knowledge and understanding of ETL/ELT processes to create and/or expand the current data model Utilize a variety of technologies, including SQL, R, Python, and other relevant tools, to manage and analyze large amounts of education data. Implement data hygiene practices to ensure statistical efficiency, accuracy, and quality in educational data. Collaboration and Stakeholder Engagement Work closely with global and district-level stakeholders, including educators, IT professionals, compliance teams, and risk management, to identify, support, and implement data-driven projects. Establish relationships with IT leaders, systems leaders, data engineers, and technical specialists to advance proposed architectural solutions. Team Membership Represent the team in architectural discussions, focusing on data aggregation, data flows, deployment strategies and governance. Have a passion for innovation with a test and learn mindset, ensuring the team remains adaptable to evolving educational needs. Agile Development and Delivery Embrace Agile methodologies in the development process, supporting the effective scaling of digital pilot initiatives from ideation to working pilots and deliverables. Other Responsibilities Collaborate with Research and Evaluation team to build consistent, accurate and available data solutions in specialized software (i.e. PowerBI, Tableau, Excel, etc) Independently define problem statements and extract user requirements for data analysis and business intelligence solutions Develop and present analyses and reports using data visualization and storytelling best practices Produce documentation to ensure consistency, quality and transparency across the district Participate in data quality issue analysis and resolution recommendations Combine data files from multiple sources efficiently and effectively to create a clean data set for analysis Write custom SQL queries Foster a continuous learning, professional development and growth mindset amongst team members Maintain department procedures and policies in alignment with district, state and federal statutes and regulations Prepare various reports for professional, technical, and non-technical audiences to provide and/or convey information Collaborate with senior engineer and other team members in the department to ensure accurate visualizations, data elements and consistent practices are adhered to. Produce documentation to ensure data consistency, quality and transparency across the district Provide training on the proper and effective use of data tools Assist other personnel as may be required for the purpose of supporting them in the completion of their work activities Required Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, STEM, or other related field, advanced degree preferred Minimum of 2 years of data analysis and/or engineering in a K-12 educational system or related field Skills & Competencies: Models the attributes and skills of the MPS Portrait of a Graduate Demonstrates commitment to the MPS Promise that every student is known by name, served by strength and need, and graduates ready for college, career and community Proficient knowledge of data analytics, data wrangling and data blending/integration Proficient knowledge of data visualization and/or reporting tools (e.g. PowerBI, Tableau, IBM Cognos, etc) Proficiency in SQL and experience in cloud solutions (e.g. Azure, AWS, etc.) Ability to write and utilize SQL to extract, ingest and manipulate data. Understanding of database and cloud architecture, with experience in cloud-based data storage and warehousing Familiarity with Agile Development and Delivery, source control and the software development life cycle Demonstrated ability to independently conduct ad-hoc data analysis and reporting. Proficient in data processing technologies and Agile development processes. Strong analytical abilities and problem-solving skills Demonstrated skill and knowledge of computer applications in the use of research and analysis (Excel, R, etc.) Ability to communicate, both verbally and in writing, clearly and effectively for all levels and types of audiences (technical and non-technical) Strong leadership skills with a self-starter attitude and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously. Work Environment & Physical Requirements: Primarily works in an office with a computer and multiple monitors Works closely with IT staff, data analysts, administrators, and educators to ensure data accuracy and support decision-making Required to meet reporting deadlines for funding, compliance, and district performance evaluations Requires extended periods of sitting and working on a computer Primarily a desk job, but may involve setting up data systems, troubleshooting servers, or working with IT hardware Occasional travel within the district to different schools or offices for meetings or system support Equal Opportunity Employer Statement: Mesa Public Schools is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local laws regarding equal employment opportunity and anti-discrimination. The District strictly prohibits and does not tolerate discrimination against employees, applicants, or any other covered persons because of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law. Applicants and employees may contact Human Resources to request reasonable accommodations needed to perform the essential functions of this position.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Data Engineer - Hybrid in San Francisco - $130,000-150,000 About the Opportunity We are seeking a Data Engineer to join a growing data team and help scale the data foundation of a rapidly expanding business. This is a high-impact role supporting critical operational functions across manufacturing, inventory management, project delivery, and business operations. Reporting to the Analytics Engineering function, you will own and enhance core data pipelines, improve data quality and visibility across business systems, and help stakeholders make better operational decisions through reliable, accessible data. This position offers significant ownership, autonomy, and exposure to leadership as the organization continues to scale. What You'll Do Data Engineering & Pipeline Development Own, maintain, and optimize approximately 20 existing production data pipelines. Design, build, and deploy new data pipelines to support business growth and evolving operational requirements. Develop and maintain scalable ETL/ELT processes across multiple business systems. Monitor data workflows, troubleshoot issues, and ensure high levels of reliability and accuracy. Improve data architecture, data quality, and pipeline performance. Operational Data & Systems Integrate data from ERP, project management, design, manufacturing, inventory, and operational systems. Ensure source system accuracy and integrity to support reporting and decision-making. Build solutions that provide visibility into manufacturing output, inventory levels, project status, and operational performance. Ingest and manage public datasets to support strategic business initiatives and market analysis. Cross-Functional Partnership Partner with stakeholders across operations, manufacturing, supply chain, project management, and business teams. Gather requirements, identify opportunities for automation, and deliver actionable data solutions. Translate technical concepts into clear business insights for non-technical stakeholders. Serve as a trusted partner helping teams leverage data to improve efficiency and execution. What Success Looks Like During your first 6 to 12 months, you will: Become the primary owner of critical operational data pipelines. Improve visibility into key manufacturing and inventory workflows. Increase confidence in source-system data quality and reporting accuracy. Build new data products and integrations that help teams scale efficiently. Create stronger data connectivity across operational functions and business stakeholders. Required Qualifications 2-4 years of experience in Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, or a related field. Advanced SQL skills with a strong understanding of relational databases. Experience building, maintaining, and scaling data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes. Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities. Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. Proven track record of owning problems end-to-end and delivering business impact. Experience working across multiple domains rather than a narrowly specialized technical scope. Preferred Qualifications Experience working with ERP platforms, particularly NetSuite or similar enterprise systems. Experience with transactional databases and operational business systems. Proficiency in Python. Experience with dbt, Spark, Databricks, or modern data platforms. Experience integrating APIs and third-party data sources. Familiarity with TypeScript or software engineering fundamentals.

jobs.title: Business Intelligence Engineer
jobs.description: Westgate Resorts is the largest privately held timeshare company in the world , with 60+ resorts in top destinations like Orlando, Las Vegas, Gatlinburg, Park City, and Myrtle Beach. Recognized by U.S. News & World Report as one of the Best Companies to Work For , we’re committed to creating a supportive, rewarding workplace where our 9,000 Team Members can grow and thrive. Since 1982, we’ve delivered unforgettable vacations through exceptional service, innovation, and community engagement. With the recent addition of VI Resorts by Westgate, our footprint now includes the Pacific Northwest, Hawaii, Canada, and Mexico . Join us and be part of a team that values passion, integrity, and excellence, where your work helps create memories that last a lifetime. Job Description The Business Intelligence Engineer is responsible for designing and maintaining scalable data pipelines, transforming raw data into analytics-ready datasets, and developing robust reporting solutions that support strategic decision-making across Westgate. Approximately 65% of this role consists of backend ETL development using SQL, Alteryx, Python, and Snowflake, and 35% involves building Tableau dashboards, analytical reports, and business insights. The Engineer supports a wide range of business functions including Inventory Control, Yield, Operations, Call Center/Dialer, Loyalty/Owner Engagement, and Executive leadership. This role gathers business requirements, interprets operational logic, and translates them into automated workflows and scalable BI solutions that improve data quality, operational efficiency, and revenue performance. This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship (H-1B, L-1, O-1 or CPT/OPT). Backend ETL Development (≈ 65%) Designs, builds, and maintains automated data pipelines using SQL, Alteryx, Python, Snowflake, and Oracle . Gathers and documents business requirements and operational logic from stakeholders across the org. Translates nuanced business rules from Yield, Inventory, Operations, Dialer, and Loyalty into accurate and scalable ETL processes. Cleans, transforms, reconciles, and validates large datasets from LMS, TSW, Oracle, and other systems. Optimizes pipeline performance, reliability, and data freshness. Partners with IT on schema alignment, integration issues, and resolving data flow inconsistencies. Maintains documentation for data models, transformation logic, and pipeline dependencies. Reporting Development & Dashboarding (≈ 35%) Develop, enhance, and maintain Tableau dashboards used across Inventory, Operations, Marketing, Call Center/Dialer, Loyalty/Owner Engagement, and executive teams. Build reporting assets that support forecasting, budgeting, operational oversight, and yield optimization. Conduct unit testing and validate output logic to ensure accuracy and consistency. Improve report design, automation, usability, and performance for business stakeholders. Business Support, Analysis & Insights Provide analytical and reporting support across multiple operational domains, including: Inventory Control & Yield Management Operations & Resort Performance Call Center / Dialer Performance & Workforce Management Loyalty / Owner Engagement & Retention Sales, Finance, and Executive Leadership Analyze trends, performance drivers, call behavior, channel utilization, and operational metrics to identify risks, inefficiencies, or opportunities. Develop insights and recommendations that inform staffing, revenue strategies, inventory allocation, owner engagement, and overall operational efficiency. Support ad hoc business questions by building quick-turn analyses and clearly presenting findings. Cross-Functional Collaboration Partners with stakeholders across Inventory, Marketing, Operations, Loyalty, Finance, Call Center, and IT to gather requirements and understand process logic. Facilitates requirement-gathering sessions to ensure ETL workflows and reporting outputs reflect real business rules and KPIs. Works with IT to ensure accuracy, alignment, and performance across data sources. Collaborates with operational leaders to implement analytical solutions and validate results. Data Integrity & Quality Assurance Performs routine validation, reconciliation, and quality checks across systems and automated workflows. Investigates anomalies and escalate issues appropriately. Ensures final reporting outputs meet high standards of accuracy, reliability, and consistency. Other duties as assigned. Qualifications To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Experience 3-5 years of relevant experience developing ETL workflows in Alteryx, Python, and/or comparable tools. Education & Certifications Associate’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or related field. Bachelor’s degree preferred. Skills/Knowledge Familiarity with Snowflake, Oracle, LMS, TSW, and enterprise data ecosystems. Proficiency with Tableau or similar data visualization tools. Advanced Excel proficiency (pivot tables, formulas, modeling). Ability to manage large datasets and perform detailed reconciliation. Ability to understand complex operational processes and translate them into technical requirements. Strong quantitative skills, with the ability to interpret trends and identify business impacts. Understanding of sales forecasting, yield concepts, call center metrics, and operational KPIs. Ability to learn and adapt quickly to new processes and technologies. Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders. Strong verbal and written communication skills. Comfortable facilitating requirement sessions and documenting business rules. Ability to present insights and findings clearly and professionally. Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy. Ability to work independently and cross-functionally. Demonstrated initiative, follow-through, and problem-solving ability. Ability to independently analyze complex situations, identify patterns and trends, and evaluate multiple options for solving complex or ambiguous problems. Ability to adapt to changing circumstances.
